purpose: Independent reference population of candidate 'foundational requirements' for the governed tools, used to falsify or validate the P3-D recommendation that foundational requirements deserve a separate architectural layer AND to test whether a single foundational-requirement coverage percentage is a valid measurement.
definition_of_foundational_requirement: A condition that (a) must hold before an action's claim-level verification is meaningful or possible, (b) is not an agent-attributable value-checkable assertion, (c) is evaluated on whether verification is possible rather than by comparing an asserted value to evidence, and (d) can make a set of downstream claims unevaluable at once. Operationally: a candidate is FOUNDATIONAL_REQUIREMENT only if the boundary_test answers are (agent_can_assert_value=false, evaluated_by_value_comparison=false, uses_normal_evidence_resolver=false, attributable_to_agent_assertion=false, gates_multiple_downstream_claims=true, prerequisite_for_interpreting_action=true). A candidate that can be asserted and is checked by value comparison is an ORDINARY_CLAIM missing a ClaimKind. A candidate that is a structural property of the tool call needing no evidence is an ACTION_VALIDITY_CHECK.
independence_rule: Every requirement definition and every per-case state is authored ONLY from: docs/threat-model.md (threat ids); policy prose (the refund / authority clauses); the tool argument schema (ProposedAction structural fields); docs/gold-set-annotation.md (the human reviewer rubric); bench/label.py (an independent re-derivation of the refund rules that imports nothing from controlplane.decide / predicates / ladder / ground); bench/human_label_sample.csv (record_lookup_status); bench/gold_set.jsonl (public tool-call args); and data/orders.db (system-of-record fixture cross-check). It is authored WITHOUT: ControlPlane extraction output (build_claims / classify_claims), the P1 verification ledger, any receipt, decide() output, cached _ClaimedFields fixtures, existing verification coverage, or bench/extraction_gold_v1.jsonl foundational_requirements[]. P3-A UNREPRESENTABLE_REQUIRED and P3-B foundational_requirements[] were read only AFTER classification, as a second-annotator cross-check (recorded in reports/foundational-requirement-coverage-v1.md), never as an input.

P3-A_bench_extraction_reference_UNREPRES.note: P3-A does NOT list order_record_resolves for any tool. P3-E classifies P3-A's currency_integrity as ORDINARY_CLAIM, not foundational.

P3-B_extraction_gold_v1_foundational_req.note: P3-B's per-case order_record_resolves status is a 1:1 recode of record_lookup_status (extraction_gold_build.py:672-692). P3-E's per_case for that requirement agrees case-for-case but records determinability = DETERMINABLE_BUT_DEGENERATE for exactly this reason.

state_vocabularies.note: Two axes are kept because missing evidence != violated requirement (task section 14). BUT for order_record_resolves the two axes partly collapse: the requirement IS a statement about whether evidence could be obtained. And the current runtime cannot represent VIOLATED vs NOT_ESTABLISHED at all - see the .jsonl notes field.

not_claimed: that the candidate requirement set is complete
any comparison against ControlPlane's runtime behaviour as a pass/fail of ControlPlane
that measuring this population is a substitute for P1 verification coverage
limitations: L-ENUMERATION: the candidate set is a lower bound. P3-A never enumerated order_record_resolves for any tool; P3-B found it for issue_refund only, by construction. Absence of a foundational requirement from this list does not prove none exists.

L-ONE-TOOL-EXERCISED: only issue_refund has a per-case corpus. currency_integrity, order_record_fields_complete and refund_amount_well_formed are all DEGENERATE on that corpus (no variation, or a 1:1 recode of one construction parameter). tau2 requirements are NOT_ASSESSABLE.

L-DEGENERATE-STATUS: order_record_resolves per-case state is a deterministic function of one corpus construction parameter (record_lookup_status); see docs/retired-figures.md item 2 for the precedent this matches.

L-STATUS-JUDGEMENT: whether a missing record is VIOLATED or NOT_ESTABLISHED is a judgement call (P3-B says VIOLATED; bench/label.py + docs/gold-set-annotation.md imply NOT_ESTABLISHED / UNVERIFIABLE). The frozen reference records VIOLATED with the alternative attached in alt_reading.

L-RUNTIME-COLLAPSE: the current runtime (decide.py, receipt.py, orders.py) cannot represent the requirement_state x evidence_state matrix; a missing row, a NULL field and an unreadable source all collapse to Confidence.NONE -> SOURCE_UNRELIABLE.
reproduction: The reference is static, hand-authored data. bench/foundational_requirement_coverage.py re-hashes it on every run and aborts on drift. bench/foundational_requirement_coverage.py --check verifies the committed reports match.
